verdict.rationale: Hatchet is explicitly a platform for orchestrating background tasks and durable workflows. Its SDK can create and manage cron triggers that run workflows on a schedule, and the platform adds automatic retries, durability and alerting for unattended execution. Community users praise its trigger-based flows. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party detail beyond page titles for cron and scheduled runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of recurring schedules running autonomously in production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Hatchet is a platform for orchestrating background tasks, AI agents, and durable workflows at scale.
Create and manage cron triggers that run workflows on a schedule
A single platform for orchestrating AI agents, scheduling background tasks, and running mission-critical workflows
Hatchet provides a full platform for queuing, automatic retries, durability, real-time monitoring, alerting, and logging.
the central orchestration system that manages workflows, schedules tasks, and coordinates worker execution
